## Outcome

PR #292 could turn off automatic legend-based selection, but it also removed an explicit selection that the layer still needed. I wanted a narrower option.

I built a WorldBank example where a layer should continue filtering by `year`, keep the `region` colour legend visible, and avoid silently adding `region` to `showSelected`.

## Context

Issue #333 separated two behaviors that PR #292 had treated together: the selection named by the user and the selection variable added automatically because a legend is interactive.

## What I Did

- Opened [PR #336](https://github.com/animint/animint2/pull/336) from the behavior described in [Issue #333](https://github.com/animint/animint2/issues/333).
- Added a failing WorldBank test for explicit `year` selection with a visible `region` legend.
- Implemented `showSelected.legend = FALSE` in the compiler and removed that compiler-only parameter before export.
- Began replacing the earlier `showSelected = character()` special case and continued review cleanup in PR #286.

## Learnings

The example made the bug clearer than the compiler code did: I asked the layer to filter by `year`, but the colour legend was quietly adding `region` as well. The new argument controls only that automatic addition.

## Challenges / Notes

Because `showSelected.legend` begins with `showSelected`, R could partially match the wrong parameter. I later added a regression test for that exact case.

## Next Week Targets

Stabilize the browser CI failures and begin testing multiline facet-strip labels.

## Demo / Media

::: {.evidence-panel .historical-behavior-panel}
### WorldBank selection semantics

**Explicit behavior:** `showSelected = "year"` remains active.

**Legend behavior:** `showSelected.legend = FALSE` prevents `region` from being added automatically.

**Historical status:** Open and ready at the August 24 cutoff; merged August 25, 2026.
:::

::: {.animint-live-demo .animint-demo-week-2}
<iframe src="week2-showselected-legend-demo/index.html" title="Interactive WorldBank visualization demonstrating showSelected.legend false" loading="lazy"></iframe>
:::

Choose a year in the lower plot or a region in the legend. The scatterplot still filters explicitly by `year`, while the visible `region` legend is not injected into that layer's `showSelected` variables.

<details class="demo-code">
<summary>View the essential R code</summary>

```r
animint(
  scatter = ggplot() +
    geom_point(
      aes(fertility.rate, life.expectancy, colour = region, key = country),
      showSelected = "year",
      showSelected.legend = FALSE,
      clickSelects = "country",
      data = WorldBank
    ),
  timeline = ggplot() + make_tallrect(WorldBank, "year"),
  selector.types = list(year = "single")
)
```

</details>

This bundle is isolated from the cutoff demos and is never included in the August 24 merge total.
